name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: House candidate wins primary despite ending campaign, beating Trump endorsee
changes.summary: Thomas Smith won Michigan's 8th District GOP primary on Tuesday — even though he had suspended his campaign in mid-July. Even more surprisingly: He defeated a Trump-endorsed candidate.

changes.title: Dasha Burns presses Mike Johnson on the economy, Iran and Trump's agenda
changes.summary: Dasha Burns presses Mike Johnson on the economy, Iran and Trump's agenda lead image.

changes.title: Trump says deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come as early as Wednesday
changes.summary: Iran and Oman inched toward an agreement on the critical waterway that could ease pressure on the global economy and potentially help bring an end to the war.

changes.title: Judge criticizes Trump's Justice Department as he says he has no choice but to dismiss Jan. 6 seditious conspiracy case
changes.summary: The move Tuesday closes the book on the Jan. 6 cases that were wiped out with Republican President Donald Trump's sweeping pardons and commutations last year, freeing from prison people convicted of violent of assaults on police and other crimes.

changes.title: House Democrats just added 12 'safe' Trump districts to their midterm election target list
changes.summary: The move brings the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee's list of targets to 58, an ambitious list that reflects President Donald Trump's diminished standing with the electorate and Democrats' belief that they can capitalize on voters' frustrations.

changes.title: How Trump made an estimated $2.2 billion during the first year of his second term
changes.summary: New York Times reporter Eric Lipton discusses his Pulitzer Prize-winning investigations into Trump's conflicts of interest and whether he's exploiting the power of the presidency for self-enrichment.

changes.title: FAA is investigating why a plane was allowed to take off as Trump's helicopter approached
changes.summary: The White House emphasized that President Trump was not in danger during the incident.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s most vocal opponents on the right were sowing the seeds for a future third-party political organization during a weekend get-together aimed at undercutting the Republican establishment. The meeting at Tucker Carlson’s compound in Maine with Rep. Thomas Massie, former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene.

changes.title: Cost of Trump’s Namesake Warships Likely to Rise by 50 Percent or More
changes.summary: President Trump’s goal of building a “golden fleet” of 15 battleships could cost $275 billion, according to a government estimate.

changes.title: AP Report: Trump's immigration crackdown has detained more than 50 military spouses and parents
changes.summary: President Donald Trump's administration has detained dozens of parents and spouses of active-duty U.S. troops as it rolls back immigration protections for military families to pursue its mass deportation agenda, an Associated Press investigation found.
